info.title: Console Gyro Bridge
info.author: Pianist13r
info.description: Use the Switch OLED gyro with an attached Hori Split Pad
info.details: An Atmosphère sysmodule for handheld play. When a game requests motion input and the attached controller provides none, Console Gyro Bridge supplies it from the console's built-in motion sensor. Buttons and sticks work as usual.\n\nReboot into Atmosphère after installing, then enable motion controls in a supported game. To disable the module, remove atmosphere/contents/4200000000475952/flags/boot2.flag from the SD card and reboot.

changelog: Improves sensor handoff when switching between games. Removes runtime diagnostic logging.
